add_light.title: Add a reset light
add_light.description: Reset the light first (switch it off and on 3 times: it blinks). Lights waiting for keys are searched through the Bluetooth adapters and proxies of Home Assistant. The light receives the keys of this mesh network and an address in 0x7E00–0x7EFF; it will not appear in the Nordlux app.

light_unresponsive.title: Nordlux light « {name} » is not responding
light_unresponsive.description:
The light « {name} » ({address}) has not answered the state reads for about {minutes} minutes, although a Bluetooth proxy of the mesh network is reachable.

Check that it is powered (wall switch) and within range of a proxy or another Nordlux light. If it was reset or added again elsewhere (Nordlux app), remove it here and add it again.

This alert disappears as soon as the light answers.

proxies_unreachable.title: Nordlux: no Bluetooth proxy reachable
proxies_unreachable.description:
The state of the Nordlux lights could not be read for about {minutes} minutes: no proxy of the list answers ({error}).

Check the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy (powered, connected to Home Assistant) and that it is within range of a Nordlux light or of the bridge.

This alert disappears as soon as a read succeeds.
